basis.governing_question: Why do property and health claims take too long to settle, and which claims operating model should Atlântico Seguros move to?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish why property and health claims take too long to settle and where the delay concentrates.

gate.label: Diagnostic readout
gate.decision: Do these findings and priorities set the scope for the operating model design?

phases.name: Design
phases.objective_one_line: Define the claims operating model Atlântico Seguros should move to and the path to reach it.

gate.label: Final Board readout
gate.decision: Does the steering group approve the recommendation for the Board presentation?

workstreams.name: Settlement time baseline
workstreams.answers: How long do property and health claims take to settle today, and where does time accumulate?
activities: Map property and health claim flows from notice to payment
Analyze operational data on settlement time by claim stage
Review what the 2024 motor claims lean program changed

deliverables.name: Property and health claims process and settlement baseline

workstreams.name: Pain points and satisfaction
workstreams.answers: What do claims staff and customers experience as causes of delay, and where does satisfaction stand?
activities: Interview the COO, the Head of Claims and claims handlers
Review customer satisfaction data and complaints on claims
Synthesize pain points by claim type

deliverables.name: Interview synthesis of claims pain points

workstreams.name: Delay drivers and priorities
workstreams.answers: Which causes of delay matter most, and which areas should the operating model design address?
activities: Quantify delay by cause across claim stages
Test the causes with claims leadership and handlers
Rank improvement areas by effect on settlement time

deliverables.name: Root causes of settlement delay by claim type
Diagnostic readout with prioritized improvement areas

workstreams.name: Target model options
workstreams.answers: Which claims operating models could cut settlement time without lowering customer satisfaction?
activities: Define options for organizing property and health claims
Compare options against the diagnostic findings
Test options with the COO and Head of Claims

deliverables.name: Claims operating model options with comparison

workstreams.name: Detailed model design
workstreams.answers: How would the chosen claims operating model work in processes, roles and governance, within the current claims IT system?
activities: Design claims processes and roles for the chosen model
Specify governance and decision rights for claims
Check the design with claims handlers

deliverables.name: Detailed design of the chosen claims operating model

workstreams.name: Impact case and Board pack
workstreams.answers: What will the chosen model do to settlement time and customer satisfaction, and what goes to the Board?
activities: Set targets for settlement time and customer satisfaction
Estimate the effect of the chosen model on both targets
Prepare the written report and Board presentation

deliverables.name: Settlement time and satisfaction targets with measures
Written report and Board presentation on the claims model

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Align scope, plan and access to claims data
events.decision: Does the steering group confirm the scope and plan for the diagnostic?
agenda: Present the engagement scope and phase plan
Align on interviews and access to claims data
Confirm steering group roles and meeting dates

events.label: Check-in: early findings
events.purpose: Share early baseline and interview findings
events.decision: Should the diagnostic focus change before delay causes are quantified?
agenda: Review interview themes and satisfaction data
Confirm the focus for the remaining weeks

events.label: Diagnostic readout
events.purpose: Decide on findings and design focus
events.decision: Do these findings and priorities set the scope for the operating model design?
agenda: Present root causes of settlement delay
Decide the scope of the design phase

events.label: Workshop 1: model options
events.decision: Which model option should be developed into the detailed design?
agenda: Present the claims operating model options
Discuss targets for settlement time and satisfaction
Decide which option goes into detailed design

events.label: Final Board readout
events.purpose: Approve the recommendation for the Board
events.decision: Does the steering group approve the recommendation for the Board presentation?
agenda: Present the detailed design and transition roadmap
Review the written report and Board presentation
Decide on approval for the Board

architect_notes: Engagement length is not given; the 12-16 week total (Diagnostic 5-7, Design 7-9) is an estimate from the archetype, within 19 weeks available.
Not covered by the phases: ASF, supervisor issued new guidance on claims-handling response times. Confirm whether it is in scope.
The brief wants a recommendation, not implementation support, so rollout of the chosen model after the Board decision is not in these phases.
Replacing the claims IT system is out of scope, so the model design is planned to work within the current system.
